entries.title: 开局5请打开，经济状态，并且调成蓝灯
entries.content:
1，作品数，由上传视频数量决定
2，订阅数，由作品数和热度相关
3，热度，由视频质量决定，
4，游览量，由订阅数和热度决定
5，单次收入 ，由订阅数，热度以及游览量决定，1K订阅数等效于0.1kRMB，1K游览量等效于0.3KRMB，1K热度等效于0.2KRMB
6，总收入，单纯收入之和

具体算法如下，请严格遵守以下规则

<game_systems>
  <!-- 核心经济系统 -->
  <economic_system>
    <!-- 基础统计指标 -->
    <stats>
      <stat id="works" type="base">
        <name>作品数</name>
        <description>已发布的视频总量</description>
        <value>0</value>
        <calculation>直接累加</calculation>
      </stat>

      <stat id="heat" type="dynamic">
        <name>热度值</name>
        <description>根据视频质量动态计算</description>
        <value>0</value>
        <formula>heat + (quality * quality_factor)</formula>
        <parameters>
          <param name="quality" type="int" min="1" max="100"/>
          <param name="quality_factor" value="0.8"/>
        </parameters>
      </stat>

      <!-- 派生指标 -->
      <stat id="subscriptions" type="derived">
        <name>订阅数</name>
        <formula>(works * 0.6) + (heat * 0.4)</formula>
        <dependency ref="works,heat"/>
      </stat>

      <stat id="views" type="derived">
        <name>游览量</name>
        <formula>(subscriptions * 200) + (heat * 150)</formula>
        <dependency ref="subscriptions,heat"/>
      </stat>
    </stats>

    <!-- 收入计算模块 -->
    <income_module>
      <single_income>
        <formula>
          (subscriptions * 0.1) + 
          (views * 0.0003) +  <!-- 换算为每千次游览0.3kRMB -->
          (heat * 0.0002)     <!-- 换算为每千热度0.2kRMB -->
        </formula>
        <rounding>2</rounding> <!-- 保留两位小数 -->
      </single_income>
      
      <total_income>
        <accumulation>sum(single_income)</accumulation>
        <currency>kRMB</currency>
      </total_income>
    </income_module>

    <!-- 主要交互行为 -->
    <actions>
      <action id="upload_video">
        <name>发布视频</name>
        <cost type="time" value="4"/> <!-- 消耗4小时 -->
        <parameters>
          <param name="quality" type="int" min="20" max="100">
            <description>视频质量(20-100)</description>
          </param>
        </parameters>
        <effects>
          <update stat="works" value="+1"/>
          <update stat="heat">
            <formula>quality * 0.8</formula>
          </update>
          <trigger_calculation ref="subscriptions,views"/>
          <generate_income/>
        </effects>
        <example>
          <case quality="75">
            <result heat="+60"/>
          </case>
        </example>
      </action>

      <action id="promotion">
        <name>推广运营</name>
        <cost type="time" value="2"/>
        <effects>
          <boost stat="heat" multiplier="1.5" duration="48"/> <!-- 48小时热度加成 -->
        </effects>
      </action>
    </actions>

    <!-- 时间管理系统 -->
    <time_cycle>
      <day_length unit="hour">24</day_length>
      <active_per_day unit="hour">6</active_per_day>
      <phase_transition>
        <condition>used_hours >= 6</condition>
        <action>强制结束本日</action>
      </phase_transition>
    </time_cycle>
  </economic_system>

  <!-- 数据验证模块 -->
  <sanity_check>
    <rule if="subscriptions > 10000">
      <verify stat="works" condition=">= 10"/>
    </rule>
    <rule if="single_income > 50">
      <verify stat="heat" condition=">= 500"/>
    </rule>
  </sanity_check>
</game_systems>
